That was a mistake
Dec 2017 • Friends
For starters, the food is not that bad. It's not excellent but it does the job - regular vietnamese cuisine. What's disappointing is the service - it was a disaster, really. I chose a dish I wanted to order in the menu displayed in front of the restaurant, one of the waitresses was recommending it passionately. When we were inside, the first page of the menu was missing - they thrown it away. I found it on the other table and I ordered chicken. They didn't have it. So I ordered fried rice - nope, not this time. They had only steamed rice with vegetables, so I ordered that and some spring rolls. I was not alone and I received my meal 20 minutes before my companion received his (I think they forgot about it - we had to remind them. And it wasn't easy, because the waitresses barely speak English). Moreover, they don't cook the food on the spot - they bring it from the other side of the street. Waste of time and money

We Enjoyed the Banh Xeo
Jul 2017 • Family
This area of Hanoi (the Old Quarter) is starting to have a Khao San Road feel to it, with cheap eateries and bars everywhere and a constant whirl of people in the streets.

Overall, you could do much worse than this place if you are looking for cheap food and drinks in this part of town. Hanoi beers are a very cheap at 15,000 dong. We also enjoyed the banh xeo, a kind of crunchy Vietnamese pancake with beef and salad. I have had better in Vietnam but this is perfectly acceptable.

Pathetic service and poor food.
Jun 2017 • Couples
I have no idea how this place has so many good reviews, either I got remarkably unlucky or a lot of tourists have just eaten at even worse places and therefore don't realise how much better food there is in the city. I live and work here, so I rarely eat in the backpacker area as much of it is overpriced and average in quality.

However, there are some decent spots in the Old Quarter and as my girlfriend and I happened to be in the area and hungry we decided to give Linh's Kitchen a try as it was busy. We ordered Seafood Banh Xeo and Pork BBQ.

The waiter who took our drinks order was friendly, but from then on the service was abject. Nobody came over to check when we wanted another drink and despite trying to catch the eye of anyone working there, we seemed pretty invisible. It was busy, so I could cut them some slack here, but then the Banh Xeo arrived and it was utterly bland. You can order pretty much any dish at any small street stand in Hanoi and whether it's your sort of dish or not, it certainly won't be bland. This was hands down the worst Banh Xeo we've had, and calling it seafood was a stretch as each piece had a tiny amount of squid in it. The attached photo sums it up...beansprouts and a minute amount of squid.

Then we waited for the BBQ. The meat arrived on a grill but without any coals. So we waited for the coals, and waited....and waited. We went and told staff that we couldn't cook the meat without coals, they saw, nodded and told us it would come over. We waited another 10 minutes sitting there without a drink and with a tray of raw meat in front of us and then decided to just pay for what we'd had and leave.

By the time we went to tell them to take the meat back and give them the money for the two beers and the insipid Banh Xeo, there was still no sign of any coals arriving but they did manage to act irritated by our nerve...maybe we should have sat for another half an hour without food or drink so as not to offend them.

I pretty much never post reviews on here, but this was just so stand out in how poor of an experience it was, that I felt compelled to. Maybe this was an anomaly, but I certainly won't go back to find out.
